title: Equality of local-scheme pullbacks descends after shrinking
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with i followed by forget to Over X equal to X.restrictFunctor, and x a point. Let H be a functor from abelian etale sheaves on X to abelian etale sheaves on Spec(O_X,x), with coefficients AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and adj an adjunction of H to direct image along X.fromSpecStalk x. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf on X. Write D_F and c_F for the explicitly constructed neighbourhood diagram and cocone [new-local-stalk-sections-comparison-map]. For opposite neighbourhoods U,V and sections s in D_F(U), t in D_F(V), if c_F(U)(s)=c_F(V)(t), there exist an opposite neighbourhood W and arrows f:U->W, g:V->W such that D_F(f)(s)=D_F(g)(t). Thus equal local-scheme pullbacks agree on a common smaller open neighbourhood.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.5, degree zero, proof steps (1)-(3), restricted to principal opens in an affine neighbourhood of x.

proof.text: Choose a common affine neighbourhood inside U intersect V using exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Cocone naturality identifies the pullbacks of both restricted sections with their original images. Subtract the restrictions; its cocone image is zero. Apply affine vanishing, then use additivity and functoriality to obtain equal restrictions of the original sections on the resulting neighbourhood.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 59.51.5, degree-zero affine vanishing, with affine-neighbourhood and additive reduction by X3

mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, including spread_out_unique_of_isGermInjective and TopCat.Presheaf.germ_ext. The former concerns morphisms of schemes, the latter already-equal presheaf germs. Neither detects equality after inverse image of an arbitrary abelian etale sheaf to the local scheme.
12 hits: uniqueness of left adjoints, its unit and counit compatibility; these are formal ingredients, not local-scheme section descent.

Mathlib Stalk.lean has fromSpecStalkOfMem and its factorization; concrete-category colimit lemmas supply representatives and equality from common restrictions. Upstream SectionContinuity and Sheaf EtaleSetSectionContinuity assume coefficients in universe one above the scheme universe and require a specified affine limit presentation. They do not directly supply the same-universe abelian neighbourhood cocone assertions here.
